shortlist.title: Admin Review
shortlist.recallDisabledHint: RM has already picked a tentative winner — recall is disabled. Use "Reject Tentative Winner" to restart the selection.

finalize.title: Award Quotation
finalize.awardBody: Awarding to {{company}} — the system will commit each appraisal's fee from the per-appraisal price the winner submitted (shown below). Click "Assign" on the task to route externally. This action cannot be undone.
finalize.awardBodyAssigning: Awarding to {{company}} — the system will commit each appraisal's fee from the per-appraisal price the winner submitted (shown below), then assign the ready appraisals to it right away. This action cannot be undone.

autoAssign.title: Assign every appraisal right after awarding
autoAssign.description: The system assigns each appraisal to the winning company, as if you opened the Administration page and chose Route to External with the quotation for each one.
autoAssign.checking: Checking whether each appraisal is ready...
autoAssign.previewFailed: Could not check whether each appraisal is ready. Retry, or turn the switch off to award without assigning and assign each appraisal on the Administration page.
autoAssign.notEnabled: Assigning to external companies is not enabled yet, so appraisals cannot be assigned from here. Award the quotation, then assign on the Administration page.
autoAssign.notStandalone: Auto-assign is only available for standalone quotations. Award the quotation, then assign on the Administration page.
autoAssign.roundRobinHint: System picks per appraisal, next in rotation
autoAssign.parkedNote: These appraisals are not at Appraisal Assignment yet: {{list}}. The quotation will be awarded, but they are parked and must be assigned by hand on the Administration page once they are back at Appraisal Assignment.
autoAssign.noneReady: No appraisal is ready to assign now. The results will be recorded on the summary.
autoAssign.manualIncomplete: Select follow-up staff for every ready appraisal
autoAssign.toastIncomplete: Awarded, but not every appraisal was assigned: {{assigned}} assigned · {{failed}} failed · {{parked}} parked · {{skipped}} skipped. The quotation's assignment summary lists what needs action.
autoAssign.toastNoResults: Awarded, but the assignment result is missing for some appraisals. Check each appraisal's status on the Administration page.
autoAssign.mayHaveCompleted: The award may have completed — refreshing.

reason.taskHeldUnknown: task is held by another user

reason.documentFollowupOpen: open document follow-up must be cleared first

assignSummary.title: Assignment result
assignSummary.assignedElsewhere: Assigned by hand on the Administration page.
assignSummary.returnedNote: Assign it on the Administration page.

reasons.deleted: The appraisal was deleted, so it was not assigned.
reasons.workflowEnded: The workflow has ended, so it was not assigned.
reasons.noAssignment: The appraisal has no assignment record, so it was not assigned.
reasons.notPending: The assignment was no longer pending when the quotation was finalized, so it was not assigned.
reasons.assignmentNotReset: The previous assignment record has not been reset yet. Assign it on the Administration page.
reasons.constructionInspection: Construction inspection appraisals are not auto-assigned. Assign it on the Administration page.
reasons.notAtAssignment: The appraisal was not at the assignment step. Assign it on the Administration page once it gets there.
reasons.taskHeld: The assignment task is held by another user. Ask them to release it, then assign it on the Administration page.
reasons.documentFollowupOpen: An open document follow-up must be cleared first. Then assign it on the Administration page.
reasons.winnerUnavailable: The winning company is not available. Check the company, then assign it on the Administration page.
reasons.unpriced: The winner did not quote a price for this appraisal, so it was not assigned.
reasons.stopped: Assignment stopped before it finished. Assign it on the Administration page.
reasons.unexpectedStop: Assignment stopped unexpectedly. Assign it on the Administration page.
reasons.stateUnreadable: The workflow state could not be read. Check the appraisal, then assign it on the Administration page.
reasons.staffIneligible: The follow-up staff member is not eligible for this appraisal. Assign it on the Administration page.
reasons.staffValidationFailed: The follow-up staff member could not be validated. Assign it on the Administration page.
reasons.assignFailed: Assignment failed. Try again on the Administration page.
reasons.noMatch: The workflow found no match and sent the appraisal back to assignment. Assign it on the Administration page.
reasons.workflowElsewhere: Auto-assign went through, but the workflow went to an unexpected step at that time.
reasons.unverified: Assigned, but the final state could not be confirmed at that time.

assignSummary.lockFailed: Could not lock task. Try again.
